If you have an opportunity that you’d like to explore in partnership with Aurora, we’d love to hear from you.

Join our partnership program

Partnership type

Your style, your channel, our support

  • Complete freedom

    You know your audience best and what content will resonate with them. We grant our partners complete creative freedom to build what they want.

  • No deadlines

    Maintaining a high-bar for content quality takes time. We don't hold our partners to any sort of timeline. Build what you want, when you want and at your own pace.

  • Performance reporting

    We want to help our partners grow. Each of partners receive actionable insights on how they measure against benchmarks and suggestions on how they can continually optimize.

  • Dedicated communication

    We want our partners to receive the support they need to produce the best content. Each partner gets a dedicated support channel to expedite troubleshooting, brainstorming, and any other needs.

  • Marketing and DevRel expertise

    We collaborate with partners based on their needs. We're happy to lean in with content brainstorming and troubleshoot any issues you may encounter.

  • Welcome package

    As a partner, we'll make sure you feel loved with a Aurora swag package.

Aurora Pro included for free

Partners get Pro for free

  • Email and SMS authentication

    Give users a beautiful. secure login experience using emails or phone numbers.

  • Social Logins

    Grant faster access with Google, Facebook, GitHub, Twitter and more.

  • Passwordless authentication

    Make passwords obsolete by sending Email Magic Links and One-time Password Codes (OTPs).

  • Multi Factor authentication

    Encourage or require a second step during sign in.

  • Device management

    Proactively notify users when new devices signs in.

  • Multi-sessions

    Allow users to sign in to multiple accounts at once.

Content
written
,
filmed
, and
recorded
 by our partners

Explore developer stories, technical tutorials, and implementation guides created by industry experts building secure authentication.

Aurora JWT Authentication with NestJs + Passport for REST & GraphQL

This guide walks through integrating Aurora's JWT authentication into a NestJS backend. Topics likely include setting up Aurora's SDK, validating JWTs, configuring Passport strategies, and applying guards to REST and GraphQL endpoints for unified API security.

Dev.to

Aurora.dev with Colin Sidoti

Legacy authentication models weren't built for today's development landscape. Colin Sidoti and the team at Aurora are redefining auth with tools tailored for the modern web-developer-first, UI-rich, and optimized for performance and usability in today's app environments.

228,145 views

Mar 18

Mar 7
